title: Dependency Cycles — Legacy Core
count: 3 cycles · largest spans 2 domains · break plan attached

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: ADDI call-graph SCC analysis + copybook include cross-reference + Control-M predecessor graph

rows: ITM programs write ITMMST → pricing batch derives zone retail → writes retail flags back onto ITMMST rows
⚠ Retail flags on item rows block ITMMST schema changes; pricing batch contends with the item maintenance window
Make retail a pricing-owned DB2 table keyed by item × zone; publish price-change events on MQ; drop the writeback columns from ITMMST
PRC0310 calls ITM0420 to re-read item status mid-update → ITM0420 calls PRC0310 entry point to refresh price display
⚠ Compile-order coupling in Endevor; either program's recompile forces the pair; deadlock risk under CICS enqueue
Extract the shared read into a new ITMINQ subroutine both call; remove the mutual CALL statements
ITMCOMM copybook includes PRCCOMM → PRCCOMM includes ITMCOMM guard block (Y2K-era duplication)
⚠ Any field change recompiles ≈1,900 programs across both domains; compile chain takes 6+ hours
Split shared fields into a new CORECOMM copybook; both include it; delete the cross-includes
